title: A Space-time Approach to Entropy-Stable Discontinuous Galerkin and Flux Reconstruction
summary: We present a high-order space-time discretization equipped with fully-discrete entropy stability properties for general choices of volume and surface quadrature rules. The formulation uses flux reconstruction (FR) in the spatial dimension paired with a discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method in the temporal dimension. The result is a fully-implicit system using polynomial bases in space and time.
